scope: Independent read-only review of checker protocol patch and acceptance aggregation; no repository edits, builds or native runs by reviewer.

original_patch.identity_source: Manager supplied verified patch identity; reviewer inspected applied source.
reviewed_properties: Exact receipt counts and malformed-slot preservation
Watchdog failure without child-tree cleanup claims
Compatibility with stricter accept.py report aggregation

finding.description: Excessively nested JSON could parse successfully but cause RecursionError during indented report serialization, leaving no report. This was a pre-existing hardening gap, not a false-pass path.
finding.minimal_repair: Strict parse_json converts decoder RecursionError to ValueError and checks container nesting iteratively with maximum depth 128. Excessively nested receipts retain raw stdout and failed slots; excessively nested corpora are refused before launch.
finding.repair_review: Implementation and three real-subprocess regression oracles independently reviewed; no blocking findings.

focused_cases: Deep semantically valid baseline receipt retains failure evidence and successful candidate observation
Deep outer receipt retains rejected slot, exact stdout and later passing rows
Deep corpus writes failure report and launches neither engine
patched_reports: Successful tiny config checker report accepted by accept.py engine_counts/report_passed
Successful tiny outer checker report accepted by accept.py outer_counts/report_passed
Corpus mutation with individually passing engines remains failed under accept.py report_passed

historical_native_reports.purpose: Saved-report compatibility only; not fresh patched-source native evidence.
